title: step n of m in title and above form
rule: Step n of m in `document.title` and above the form — e.g. `Stap 2 van 6`. Prefer text over a progress bar (scales under zoom). If a SPA swaps steps on one URL, still update the title. Dual-cite GOV.UK “test without a progress indicator”; this names the title + heading pair and SPA title rewrite. Conditional step counts: NL says evidence is insufficient — do not invent a house rule.
pass_when: `document.title` and the heading above the form both include step n of m (text, not only a bar); SPA step swaps update the title.
fail_when: Step n of m is missing from the title or from above the form; SPA keeps a stale title; a house rule for conditional step counts is invented.
overview: `document.title` and the heading above the form both include step n of m (text, not only a bar).
not_when: Not for single form on one screen.

do_not_claim: GOLD out-of-order progress indicator; GOV.UK test-without as a merge that drops title+heading; a house conditional-count rule.
